mapper.select: select o.id, o.operate_emp_id as operateEmpId, o.operate_time as operateTime, o.class_name as className, o.method_name as methodName, o.method_params as methodParams, o.return_value as returnValue, o.cost_time as costTime, e.name as operateEmpName from operate_log o left join emp e on o.operate_emp_id = e.id order by o.operate_time desc
